description: This file implements a React component for a 'Move Note' dialog in the Notesnook application, allowing users to select notebooks and move notes between them. It includes state management, UI rendering, and interactions with a database layer.

classes.name: MoveNoteDialog
classes.description: React component for moving notes between notebooks, with UI for selecting notebooks and managing note relations.

classes.name: NotebookItem
classes.description: Component representing a notebook item in the tree, with expand/collapse and selection capabilities.

classes.name: SelectedCheck
classes.description: Component displaying selection status (checkbox) for notebooks.

methods.name: calculateIndentation
methods.description: Calculates indentation for nested notebook items based on depth and expandability.

methods.name: createSelection
methods.description: Creates a new selection reference for a notebook item.

methods.name: findSelectionIndex
methods.description: Finds index of a notebook in the selection array.

methods.name: notebookHasNotes
methods.description: Checks if a notebook contains specific notes.

methods.name: selectSingle
methods.description: Toggles selection of a single notebook.
